executive_summary: Tenth consecutive week of failure — zero trades taken, zero P&L. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is completely non-functional: it either filters out all setups (current high min_score) or takes losing trades (lower min_score). The bot has been dead money for 10+ weeks with cumulative losses of ₹-16,000 and now zero activity. This is a fundamental architecture failure requiring a complete strategy replacement, not parameter adjustment.
target_progress: 0% — 70% below 70% target. No measurable progress in 10 weeks.
regime_assessment: Regime detection correctly identified trending_down for 6 of 7 days, but this information is completely useless because the bot has no strategy that trades in trending_down regimes. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy appears to require mean-reversion conditions and generates zero signals in trends. Regime detection is working but the strategy-regime mapping is broken — there is no fallback strategy for trending markets.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: No symbol data available — zero trades means no symbol-level analysis is possible. Cannot make data-driven symbol decisions.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: No basis for focus list. Need to first establish a strategy that actually generates trades.

dow_pattern: No day-of-week pattern can be identified — zero trades across all days for the entire week. Day-of-week analysis is meaningless until the bot is actually trading.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: STOP optimizing Supply & Demand Zone parameters. The strategy has failed for 10 weeks. If forced to keep it, dramatically lower min_score to 50-70 and reduce RR to 1.2-2.0 to actually generate trades — but this is a band-aid. The real fix is structural.

structural_recommendations.change: REPLACE primary strategy entirely. Implement a trend-following strategy (e.g., moving average crossover, breakout, or momentum) as the primary strategy for trending regimes. Supply & Demand Zones are a mean-reversion approach that generates zero signals in persistent trends — which has been the dominant regime for 10+ weeks.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Moving from 0 trades/week to 5-15 trades/week. Even a 40% win rate with 1.5:1 RR would be positive expectancy vs current zero activity.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a strategy-regime router: trending_up → trend-following long, trending_down → trend-following short or cash, ranging → Supply & Demand Zones. The current architecture uses one strategy regardless of regime, making regime detection decorative.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Eliminates the core failure mode where the wrong strategy is applied to the detected regime. Expected to improve strategy-regime alignment from 0% to 70%+.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a 'circuit breaker' inactivity alert: if 0 trades are taken for 3 consecutive trading days, automatically lower min_score by 10 or switch to a backup strategy. The bot should never sit idle for 10 weeks.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Prevents prolonged dead-money periods. Ensures the bot generates at minimum 2-3 trades per week for learning and adaptation.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement paper-trade mode for new strategies: run trend-following and mean-reversion strategies in parallel on paper for 1 week, then switch live to whichever shows positive expectancy.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: De-risks strategy transitions. Allows data collection without capital risk. Expected 1-week validation cycle before going live.

structural_recommendations.change: Add short-selling or put-buying capability for trending_down regimes. The bot currently appears to have no mechanism to profit from downtrends, which dominated 6 of 7 days this week and most of the past 10 weeks.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Doubles the addressable opportunity set. In persistent downtrends, this is the difference between 0 trades and 5+ trades per week.
